title: Bomb threats disrupt at least 15 flights across Europe, raising hybrid war fears
summary_full: Planes forced into emergency landings or diversions two days after hoax alerts affected air travelEurope live – latest updatesBomb threats have caused diversions and emergency landings for at least 15 flights across Europe, renewing questions about a possibly coordinated effort to disrupt travel.The series of warnings on Thursday morning affected flights between Italy, Ireland, the UK, Spain, Bulgaria, Romania, Poland, Finland, Austria, Denmark, Belgium, Portugal, Greece and Czechia.
